notes.title: "Tales of Xillia Remastered " will be available on Oct 31st, Friday
notes.content:
Two Heroes, One Destiny

[previewyoutube=feXG0jHLpU8;full][/previewyoutube]
Announcing the release of “Tales of Xillia Remaster,” the remastered version of “Tales of Xillia,” which was released in 2011 as the 15th anniversary title of the “Tales of” series.

An RPG set in a world where humans and spirits coexist has been remastered for modern consoles, offering stunning graphics and enhanced gameplay. Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.

Product Page：https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/tales-of-xillia-remastered
Official X：https://x.com/TalesofSeries

• Two Heroes, One Destiny

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/a75b46bdb36183f3628dde08cb8159701cbdf53e.jpg
Follow the paths of Milla and Jude as they embark on their daring journey through Rieze Maxia, a wondrous land where humans and spirits coexist in harmony.

• Partner Up with Dual Raid

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/d913887cffa78164b3eb3fac7fec6b11c0efff6f.jpg
Master the Dual Raid Linear Motion Battle System, mustering strategy and coordination to overcome action-packed battles in real-time combat. Team up with allies to unleash devastating combo attacks and unlock special support skills to overwhelm your foes.

・New features added for remaster!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/1aa52fae7891762ac0f91daf4ee4f4616df72858.jpg
Explore with new quality-of-life updates including improved graphics, an auto-save feature, the ability to toggle encounters, early shop access, and more.


・Pre-order has started!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/b67dca468e044d32518556e7ae7ef469311cea12.png
Pre-order to receive the Super Adventuring Assistance Set early in your Tales of Xillia Remastered journey.

- Apple Gel x 10
- Orange Gel x 10
- Life Bottle x 10
-Panacea Bottle x 10

・Deluxe Edition is also available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/d9f87ea585df844d94554720f456b66403ebadef.png
We are now selling the digital download edition of “Deluxe Edition,” which includes luxurious bonus content.
The ‘Deluxe Edition’ includes a ‘Digital Artbook’ featuring extensive setting materials and illustrations, a ‘Digital Soundtrack’ containing all 81 in-game BGM tracks, a ‘Battle BGM pack’ that allows you to replace standard battle music with BGM from previous series installments, and a ‘Super Growth Support Herb Set’ that enhances character parameters.

- Tales of Xillia Remastered
- Battle BGM pack
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
- Super Growth Support Herb Set

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2246670/_/

notes.title: RPG worlds collide between Tales of Arise and SCARLET NEXUS ⚔️
notes.content:
An exciting crossover between Tales of Arise and SCARLET NEXUS is available today, with a free update bringing new content to both games.

In Tales of Arise, players can unleash the power of the mind with the new SCARLET NEXUS-themed content available in-game, including Myoho Murasama Replica, a new weapon for Alphen, two additional attachments, the Handmade Hair Clip Replica and Baki, as well as a new battle background music (BGM) called Opposed Viewpoint. 

In SCARLET NEXUS, players can challenge the fate that binds them with the new Tales of Arise-themed content available in-game, including the Blazing Sword for Yuito alongside the Broken Iron Mask and Owlet Doll attachments, and new Tales of Arise battle background music (BGM).

[previewyoutube=wtAmRNalwfg;full][/previewyoutube]
Released in 2021, SCARLET NEXUS challenges players to take on the role of Yuito Sumeragi or Kasane Randall as they team up with a colorful cast of characters to strike down the deranged mutants known as the Others with powerful psycho-kinetic abilities in the futuristic city of New Himuka. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/740130/Tales_of_Arise/

notes.title: Tales Of Arise: Guides and advice 📚
notes.content:
New player or returning to the series? We have 4 different kinds of guides ready to help you start your adventure in the best conditions!

Beginner guide: 10 tips to know when starting the game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/81da19bb97185650575600bb5c46d2917e3eaf66.png

If you were wondering how to play Tales Of Arise, what you should do first when starting the game or what you should know even before, this beginner’s guide is for you! It will help you out and show you how to get started!

Regardless if you played former games of the Tales of Series, this guide contains essential combat system tips and tricks you would wish to know before starting to play, to get the most out of the game!

Read the full Beginner Guide here.

Intermediate Guide: Combat mechanics advice
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/fde879cff17043280467497935859ee28a7cd3d3.png

By now, you should have played Tales Of Arise for a little while and mastered the combat system basics and you may be seeking more techniques to level up your fights and build your own fighting style, as you will be fighting against stronger monsters.

This Intermediate Guide contains some tips and advices for players who want to explore the combat mechanics and learn more about the tricks and synergies you still might not know and which can definitely be useful as you progress in the game.

Read the full Intermediate Guide here.

Expert Guide: take your game to the next level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/0aa0a6b8e765bc3bddf4ac27fc4d16725847d202.png

Take your fighting style to the next level with these advanced combat tricks and improve your skill to progress faster and easier in Tales Of Arise. Here are some tips that will help you understand how you can get the most out of Combat Points, Artes and the different Characters’ Perks!

Read the full Expert Guide here.

Pro Guide: Ultimate tips
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/ad17e7bbc96e315d59f7d34d6273dd0cc980e780.png

If you’ve read the Beginner Guide, the Intermediate Guide and the Expert Guide, you should now be able to enjoy the richness of the Combat Mechanics offered by Tales Of Arise. With this Pro Guide, we wanted to share with you the last 5 tips that will allow you to get even further in the depths of your fighting style.

Read the full Pro Guide here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/740130/Tales_of_Arise/

notes.title: Thank you for your passion and loyalty to the Tales of series ✨
notes.content:
A few days after release, Tales of Arise has surpassed 1 million units sold worldwide, making it the fastest selling title of the franchise. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/c40a1e3a34a0bf9aa1c175d6f3ae576bbd73a6b0.png

With this milestone on the critically acclaimed new episode, the Tales of franchise reaches 25 million units sold worldwide.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/52acf65d687806d9724a78faf66b2d23d67b7aee.png

“We are very proud and humbled to see fans and newcomers reception playing Tales of Arise”, said Yusuke Tomizawa, Producer on Tales of Arise. “Our goal with this title was to open the franchise to as many players as possible while maintaining the Tales of DNA and uniqueness that has allowed the franchise to stay strong for more than 25 years. We would like to thank players for their support.”

The game is now available and for players willing to give the game a try, a demo is available as well. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/740130/Tales_of_Arise/

notes.title: Tales of Arise is available now! ✨

Tales of Arise, the critically acclaimed new entry in the Tales of franchise is launching today! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373073/bf5bd3af1a39f39dc1052cec354e9662dabc4f18.png

The game puts players in the shoes of Alphen and Shionne, as they are uniting in their fight to free Dahna from the ruling of Rena. 
During their journey, they will meet a colourful cast, Rinwell, Law, Kisara and Dohalim, that will join their cause.

A free demo of the game is also available from now on PC!
Not only will you get a basic battle tutorial, but also experience all the fun of Tales of Arise, including camping, cooking, and skits, as well as sub-quests and battles against the mighty Gigant!
